01 / ROOTED IN THE LAND

A farming business.
A supply partner.

Bigfoot Meats Australia brings together its own farms, livestock rearing and meat supply. We work with carcass requirements and trade enquiries on a case-by-case basis.

02 / OUR FARMS

Quality starts
on our farms.

Our Australian farms span 15 million square feet. Our livestock graze on pasture throughout their lives, including our grass-fed Merino sheep. Our farmers focus on nutrition, careful husbandry and low-stress handling to raise quality animals and produce tender, flavourful meat for export.

Our export range includes Dorper lamb, Merino sheep, goats and cattle. Through Independent Livestock Services, we coordinate the journey from farm to airport or seaport and onward to your destination.

We work with each trade buyer to agree product specifications, quantities, delivery timing and budget. That gives your business a clear order to plan around and a team to talk to throughout the process.
